name: claude_code_invoke
description: Forward a coding request to the user's local Claude Code CLI (or, in v2, OpenAI Codex). Read-only — the coding agent runs with restricted tools (Read / Glob / Grep) and cannot edit files, run shell commands, or take any external action. EmiCode's job is to package context (CLAUDE.md + matched architecture docs) and surface the agent's reply. Multi-turn: session_id is persisted per room, so consecutive calls in the same EmiCode conversation resume the same coding-agent session.

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: The user's coding request — verbatim or lightly polished. Don't summarize.

inputs.name: information
inputs.description: Optional extra context the user mentioned in earlier turns that's relevant but not in the latest message.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for claude_code_invoke:

- task (required): The user's coding request, verbatim.
- information (optional): Earlier-turn context the latest message doesn't repeat.
